agents.name: Outreach Drafter

workflows: CEO outcome → COO plan → research → qualify → CRM Maker/Checker → outreach draft → CEO approval
channels: Tell the COO the business outcome first. Open Workflow Builder only to inspect a step.
Connect CRM on Company setup Systems if you want verified records in the system of record.
Set Policies → Action control: external messages = Approval required.

sop_documents.title: Revenue pack — first outcome
sop_documents.body:
Time-to-value: first qualified lead approved by the CEO.
1. Import ICP, disqualifiers, and offer notes into Knowledge.
2. Chat the COO with the outcome (count, deadline, spend cap, never invent, no send without approval).
3. Review the Goal Plan. Approve exceptions only.
4. Do not start in Workflow Builder.

policy_templates.suggest:
## Management style: AI suggests
- Drafts only; CEO decides.
- Never invent contact data. Unverifiable fields stay unknown.
- External messages need CEO approval.
policy_templates.after_approval:
## Management style: AI executes after approval
- Source and qualify autonomously.
- CRM writes are reversible internal records.
- External outreach waits for CEO approval.
- Prefer an honest shortfall over fabricated KPI counts.
policy_templates.autonomous:
## Management style: AI executes autonomously
- Execute within tool grants, Action control, and budgets.
- Still never invent contacts. Escalate legal/PR risk.
